## Scope

Describe the user-visible or scientific change and the modules it affects.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes.
- [ ] New scientific behavior has a numerical regression test.
- [ ] GUI changes were checked at desktop and narrow-window widths.
- [ ] User documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when behavior changes.

## Scientific provenance

List the equations, upstream source lines, reference files, or publications used to validate any numerical change.
